derived_artifacts.method: inputs/HHAN-2024-2402.11269/extract_text.py (pypdf 6.19.0 + fonttools 4.66.1, scratch venv; system Python had no pypdf)
derived_artifacts.limitation: Display equations and inline mathematics extract as glyph fragments: binomial coefficients appear as '{a+b' / '2' / ')', superscripts and subscripts are flattened onto the base line (e.g. 'gx+by', 'T 2', 'Pi'), epsilon decodes as U+01EB, and some words carry extraction-inserted spaces. Quote the prose; do not reconstruct formulas without marking the reconstruction. Without fonttools the same script yields a different file (sha256 12cbc0c24d525ac38e415280f3892a7d78b927c3c5687dcab9c347526e27dcb1, 324 diff lines, delimiter glyphs and spacing only on inspection of the first hunks); the frozen file is the fonttools one and reproduced byte-identically on a second run.
